description: This is a Python source file implementing a speech bot using Speechmatics STT and TTS services, integrated with OpenAI LLM, and designed for real-time conversation handling with transport and pipeline management.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, including message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of user and assistant responses for the LLM.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including starting and canceling.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and initiates run_bot.
